outcome: A user can download several of their attachments in one request.

acceptance_criteria.text: Attachments the user owns are returned.

expected_verification.assertion: a bulk download returns the requested attachments

acceptance_criteria.text: An attachment belonging to another account is not returned, whichever endpoint asks for it.

expected_verification.assertion: a bulk download including another account's attachment id does not return its bytes

security_impact: Cross-account read of arbitrary uploaded files, reachable by any authenticated user.
rollback: git revert removes the bulk endpoint.
